purpose: Primary-source asset/design references for an existing English apartment decor configurator. This is research only, not purchase advice.
architecture_constraint: Room geometry and apartment architecture remain locked. Adapt decor within the existing layout.
ui_guidance: Use source links and names under Reference or Inspired by, rather than claiming official replicas.
Call rendered models approximate adaptations; no official furniture 3D assets were retrieved.
Do not call any listed furniture or appliance popular, trending, best-selling or Pinterest-endorsed.
Manufacturer 2026 colour selections are factual editorial design references, not evidence of sales or consumer popularity.
Unknown source publication dates, direct image URLs and dimensions are explicitly null.
Product dimensions are variant-specific references, not validated installation or fit checks.

pinterest_context.name: Pinterest Predicts 2026
pinterest_context.classification: Factual Pinterest category forecast; independent from the catalog products.

home_trends.name: FunHaus
home_trends.factual_description: Circus-inspired interiors, bold stripes and sculptural forms.
home_trends.inspired_application: A striped textile or sculptural decor option can nod to this without changing walls or room geometry.

home_trends.name: Afrohemian Decor
home_trends.factual_description: African/bohemian mix, woven textures, textiles and natural-fibre elements.
home_trends.inspired_application: Cane/wood and woven accessories can be offered as a texture direction; do not equate generic wicker with the full cultural trend.

home_trends.name: Neo Deco
home_trends.factual_description: Art Deco reinterpretation with geometric motifs and chrome/brass details.
home_trends.inspired_application: Tailored silhouettes and small brass/chrome details can provide an optional visual direction.

pinterest_context.limitation: Forecast is source-supported category context. It does not establish popularity of Pacha, Connect Soft, Outline, the beds, appliances or paint colours.
